result: For the tensor product of the 3x3 crosshatch PPT state with itself, EVERY one of the 126^2=15876 simultaneous 4x4 coordinate cuts from its 9x9 local space has a range spanned by its complex Schmidt-rank<=2 vectors. This is an exhaustively machine-checked finite result with 2256 pinned rank2 anchor certificates and an independently written exact replay, not a proof that any cut has Schmidt number<=2 and not an all-filter or global 4x4 theorem.
source: Figure 1 of https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12966v1 defines the four unnormalized crosshatch edge kets (|10>+|02>), (|20>+|12>), (|00>+|21>), (|01>+|22>). Put Q equal to their projector sum; tr Q=8. Its exact partial transpose is the sum of the four projectors on (|12>+|00>), (|22>+|10>), (|01>+|20>), (|02>+|21>), so Q is PPT. Independently the verifier checks every one of the 81 partial-transpose entries. Reorder Q tensor Q into Alice=(A1,A2), Bob=(B1,B2); it is a 9x9 PPT state with trace64 and sixteen 4-term generator kets.
finite_certificate_argument: The four original edge supports are disjoint and each is a two-entry partial permutation. Therefore the sixteen tensor generators have pairwise disjoint supports, which remain disjoint under any coordinate cut; the nonzero projected generators are a linearly independent range basis. Each projected generator remains a 4x4 partial-permutation matrix, so its Schmidt rank is exactly its number of nonzero entries. For a given cut, all generators of rank<=2 are already allowable. For each generator of rank3 or4 the certificate lists a linear combination with coefficient1 on that generator and at most three other projected generators, all of rank<=2, yielding a rank<=2 matrix. Thus the entire basis and hence the entire actual output range is spanned by SR<=2 vectors. This works for any positive source weights on all sixteen tensor generators; the PPT assertion is for the original tensor state, or for independently PPT-weighted sources.
exact_census: There are 15876 nonzero outputs. Of these, 13688 have no rank3-or4 generator, 2120 have one, and 68 have two. The remaining 2256 individual high-rank anchors all have certificates with at most three low-rank generator terms; no bounded search failed. A single output can have two anchors. All 2256*16=36096 3x3 minors vanish in the independent replay.

artifacts.observed: Exact integer replay rebuilt all 15876 cuts, partial-permutation and disjoint-support facts, verified every certificate references only distinct rank<=2 generators with signs +/-1, checked all 36096 minors, checked exact coverage/no extra certificates, and verified all81 entries of the source partial transpose. The verifier imports no search code and uses no floats.

limitations: Only coordinate local 4x4 cuts of this specific 9x9 tensor source range. Arbitrary non-coordinate maps, the actual Schmidt number of the cuts, non-range witnesses, generic 4x4 PPT states, independent external/human review and novelty remain open.
